svg.title: Unliganded Single-pass Receptor
svg.desc: Original generic single-pass receptor with an extracellular binding region, one continuous membrane-spanning segment and a cytoplasmic tail. Ligand absence does not establish an inactive state. No named receptor structure, activity or scale is implied.
